units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98:18">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="U00538"><he>שׁוֹר</he></cite>, <cite ref="Genesis 49:6">Gen. XLIX, 6</cite>; v. Targ. O. a. Y. 1) <he>עקרתון שׁוּרָן של גרים</he> you have uprooted the stronghold (reliance) of proselytes (by dealing faithlessly with the Shechemites); <he>בשביל … עקרתם שורן וכ׳</he> in order to gratify your passion, you have uprooted &c.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 24:4">Ex. R. s. 24</cite> (play on <he>מדבר שור</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 15:22">Ex. XV, 22</cite>) <he>עד שלא יצאו … נעשה העולם ש׳</he> before Israel went out of Egypt, the world was a desert (lawless); when they went forth, the world became civilized; <he>עד שלא קיבלו … ש׳</he> before Israel received the Law, the world was a desert; when they received it, the world became &c.
